investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC triage: one unauthenticated homepage GET and, when a same-origin programme-like link was directly exposed, one additional GET. Responses were capped, no retries, browser, authentication, challenge bypass, or state-changing request.

probe_history.reason: The bounded static response did not prove a future programme; deeper structural work is deferred to a later candidate-specific package.

identity.notes: The discovery-supplied domain returned public content whose title text matches the reported candidate name.

evidence.description: Parsed, bounded passive HTTP capture containing response metadata, extracted links, and verbatim response-body prefixes; transformed/incomplete and therefore not byte-faithful.
